rationale: Ten cases, split five and five. At this size every ratio is bad: a smaller test set would make a single failure move the score by twenty points, a smaller dev set would leave nothing to iterate on. The split was built so that each half exercises as many rules as possible, using the coverage table only and no judgement about how easy a case looks. Case 008 fires no rule at all and was placed in dev, so that the already tiny test set is not spent on a case that measures nothing. The eleven rules were written while observing these ten pages, the test half included: no tuning of the system took place before this freeze, but the resulting scores will be optimistic compared to pages never observed. The correction is to grow the case set to thirty, each new case assigned to dev or test at capture time, before being read. The existing split is never reshuffled.

known_gaps.R-03: never fires, excluded from the metric
